name: session-relay
description: Keeps long tasks going when the context window fills up: a wrap-up notice, a structured handoff, and a fresh session in the same project that reads it and continues.

wrap_up_threshold.title: Wrap-up threshold (%)
wrap_up_threshold.description: Context use at which Claude is told once to wrap up gracefully.

handoff_threshold.title: Handoff threshold (%)
handoff_threshold.description: Context use at which the Stop hook asks for a handoff and starts the next session.

activation.title: Activation
activation.description: always: the relay runs in every project. opt-in: only in projects that ran /session-relay:enable.
